WITH RECURSIVE TraceLineage AS ( -- 기본(Base) 케이스: 주어진 trace_id에 해당하는 거래 노드부터 시작 SELECT t.trace_id, t.parent_trace_id, t.user_id, u.user_name, u.role, t.fish_type, t.quantity, t.sell_price, t.fair_price_status, t.created_at, 0 AS level FROM tb_watch_trade t LEFT JOIN tb_watch_user u ON t.user_id = u.user_id WHERE t.trace_id = #{traceId}::uuid
UNION ALL
-- 재귀(Recursive) 케이스: 부모 노드를 찾아 위로 거슬러 올라감 SELECT parent.trace_id, parent.parent_trace_id, parent.user_id, u.user_name, u.role, parent.fish_type, parent.quantity, parent.sell_price, parent.fair_price_status, parent.created_at, child.level + 1 AS level FROM tb_watch_trade parent INNER JOIN TraceLineage child ON child.parent_trace_id = parent.trace_id LEFT JOIN tb_watch_user u ON parent.user_id = u.user_id ) SELECT trace_id AS "traceId", parent_trace_id AS "parentTraceId", user_id AS "userId", user_name AS "userName", role AS "role", fish_type AS "fishType", quantity AS "quantity", sell_price AS "sellPrice", fair_price_status AS "fairPriceStatus", created_at AS "createdAt", level FROM TraceLineage ORDER BY level DESC
